description: python-sdk/concept-docs/health-check.md's example JSON output (the mock DiagnosticsResult/PingResult payload shown twice in the page, at two separate anchors) contains an untranslated Node.js SDK identifier: `"sdk":"libcouchbase/2.9.5-njs couchnode/2.6.9 (node/10.16.0; v8/6.8.275.32-node.52; ssl/1.1.1b)"`. `couchnode` is the Node.js SDK's package name and `njs`/`node`/`v8` are Node.js-specific runtime identifiers - this is sample output copy-pasted from the Node.js SDK's own health-check documentation and never adapted for Python. A Python developer reading this page sees a runtime stack (Node/V8) their own client never produces.
